interface.shortDescription: Build, check and run MTHDS methods. Superseded by the Pipelex plugin.
interface.longDescription: Skills for the MTHDS open standard: build methods from scratch, validate their structure and semantics, run them, and edit existing ones, with automatic .mthds file validation through a hook. Superseded by the Pipelex plugin, from the Pipelex/pipelex-plugins marketplace, which is the one to install to build and run methods from your agent.
